g.text: Standard sequencing finds about 70 DNA changes in a child that neither parent carries.

text.style: font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'Inter'; fill: #4a4741

g.text: Each extra year of the father's age at conception adds 1.51. Each year of the mother's adds 0.37.
